title: Техническая: открытие и закрытие
purpose: Charlotte Pike's short checklist, with the till rule the managing owner changed after S2.
differs_from_en: The change after S2 in its Russian form: stock is issued by the advisor against an order line only; clocked job time is reconciled with sold hours every evening; plus the two-person till count and daily banking of the English page.
The history shows what it said before: «Склад открыт, механики берут сами и записывают в тетрадь. Кассу считает тот, кто закрывает. В банк — понедельник и четверг.»
With one advisor on shift a day, the second count is the manager's or a mechanic's.
new_facts: Before the change: an open stockroom with a notebook, one count, banking on Monday and Thursday. After: issue against an order line, a nightly reconciliation of time, two counts, daily banking. ERP stock movements with no order line and orders with clocked time far above sold time do not occur at west after the rule.
Float 3 000 RUB in Kazan; differences above 100 RUB are reported.
